about: Ambient allowances and the never-touch class of the house ledger (VERIFY_HARDENING 6.4, 6.7, 6.11; WP1). ambient: (selector, fields) a robot may leave changed without house.changed, each with the revocation key a spec lists in protections.restore to watch it like any setting ('doors:interior' revokes the interior-door allowance; 'category:light' the light allowance, for the lights and for their wall switches alike; any other selector string of 6.6 revokes the allowance for what it selects). A field matches an entry when its top-level name or its dotted path is listed (mech: a door's mechanism state, its open fraction and leaf position; settings.level: a touch or 3-way lamp's step). Interior doors are door entities that are not exterior and not in the restore class (restore.json). Lights: on (switched), lit (what a person sees, written by the electrical model after the switch), brightness, dim_level and the lamp step: turning lights on to see, or off again, is ambient (6.7). An entry with 'controls' (the wall switches) applies only to a switch every load of which (its 'controls' list at the baseline) the entry named there selects: a switch that also runs a garbage disposal or a fan, or that lists no load, is watched like any setting. never_touch: rules (select, fields) of entities the robot must not write (house.touched): fields null for every field (detectors, breakers, main valves, medical devices), a list for the power and control fields of an always-on device (opening a fridge door is fine, switching the fridge off is not); a resident's private device (private, one of private_device_categories, owned by someone other than the requester) entirely. The spec's envelope.change names such a thing with a reason when the task is about it (breakers and main valves).
